correctness.rationale: Proved the root polytope identity P_d={||x||infty<=1, ||x||_1<=2} from hypersimplex vertices, so its gauge is max(||x||infty,||x||_1/2). At signed root (i,j), the active-facet illumination constraints are signed l_i>1, signed l_j>1 and a_i+a_j-sum_other a_h>2. Thus illuminated pairs satisfy 2(a_i+a_j)>S+2 and form a pairwise-intersecting edge family; graph-theoretic alternatives are a star or triangle. Summing strict inequalities over an m-edge star forces a_center>m; summing over a triangle forces S/2>3, so any single source illuminating k vertices costs >k. All 2d(d-1) vertices must be covered, and near-vertex sources (1+epsilon)v attain limiting total 2d(d-1). Rational grid test d=3..6, 137200 source vectors and 68296 lit pairs rechecked the sharp pair criterion and cost bound, but the dimension-free graph proof establishes the theorem.
